descriptor: Turn your AI chats into links you’ll be proud to share.
sampleTitle: A calmer way to build with AI

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
worth sharing.
directions.mantra: Give good work a good form.
directions.rationale: Contemporary editorial restraint. The folded page replaces the doubled F; the book image stays.
directions.alt: A fan of ivory book pages with a muted vermilion ribbon.

directions.name: Commonplace
headline: Share what
you’re learning.
directions.rationale: A human, open notebook. The plant stays; the surrounding palette gets lighter and the copy more direct.
directions.alt: An illustrated plant with green and orange leaves grows from an open notebook.

directions.name: Frame
headline: Your AI chats.
Beautifully shared.
directions.mantra: Let the work take the spotlight.
directions.rationale: A quiet gallery for your work. A thin frame and generous space let the shared idea carry the identity.
directions.alt: A translucent glass plate and ivory sheet suspended in a slim off-white frame.

directions.name: Kindred
headline: Good conversations
deserve company.
directions.rationale: Sharing as a small human gesture. Warm photography and soft type make the invitation feel personal.
directions.alt: Two hands passing a small paper note over warm linen.

directions.name: Waymark
headline: Share your thinking.
Leave a trail.
directions.mantra: A little shared today. A wider path tomorrow.
directions.rationale: Small public pieces of learning create more ways into your work. The trail grows through what you share.
directions.alt: A sparse trail of small ochre pebbles and ivory paper fragments branching over pale sand.
